plan.title: Order Activity available in RFQ evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ event that is already in evaluation.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Open the RFQ stage where its Settings menu is available.
Assert that Order Activity is offered and clickable in the current evaluation state.
Click Order Activity from the RFQ Settings menu.
Verify that the Order Activity window opens.
Close the activity window without confirming or changing anything.
Verify that the activity window closed after cancellation.
